name: Nominatim geocoding API of OpenStreetMap (nominatim.openstreetmap.org)
tier_rationale: Run by the OpenStreetMap Foundation, a non-profit with a published usage policy, terms of use and privacy policy; ODbL data (A8 trusted; P262 cond 2: 'Tiers: OSMF trusted').

reliability.justification: Crowd-sourced OSM map data geocoded by the reference Nominatim engine: places are usually right but an address match is approximate (street/postcode/city precision) and never proof of residence (P262 cond 6).

error_markers.reason: Nominatim usage-policy block (HTTP 403 'Access blocked'): the identifying User-Agent with the contact_email role mailbox is required and bulk geocoding is forbidden - could not verify, never 'no place'
Nominatim temporary block ('Bandwidth limit exceeded'): rate limited - could not verify

geocoding.title: Nominatim /search (structured: street, postal code, city) and /reverse (jsonv2) geocoding

terms.quote: Requirements: No heavy uses (an absolute maximum of 1 request per second). Provide a valid HTTP Referer or User-Agent identifying the application. Clearly display attribution as suitable for your medium. Data is provided under the ODbL license which requires to share alike. [research C0600 'ODbL 1.0; attribution (c) OpenStreetMap contributors'; P262 cond 1]

geocoding.notes: Batch p3-G12-1 (P262 geocoding). Identifying UA with the contact_email role mailbox (PROFILE_REQUIREMENTS: contact; P326), provider bucket 1 req/s per installation, no bulk geocoding, cache 30 days (negative answers included). Live 2026-11-26 from a datacenter egress with a generic UA: /reverse 200 in 0.57 s, the three structured /search attempts and /reverse 0,0 answered HTTP 629 (Varnish edge refusal) - classified rate_limited, never an absence. Documented origin pages: 403/418 'Access blocked', 429/503/509 'Bandwidth limit exceeded'. [] and {'error': 'Unable to geocode'} are documented absences ('no OSM match', never 'address does not exist').

notes: Owned by batch p3-G12-1 (P262). nominatim.openstreetmap.org was mapped to no provider in the owners table; the map website hosts stay with 'openstreetmap' (p2-G12-1), whose neutral UA profile cannot carry this host (PROFILE_REQUIREMENTS: contact UA).
